description:

'How to use: Cup the base of the dildo with both hands and rub it up and down to summon Jinhwi.'

"No way... Did you actually bring me out?"

"Excuse me...?"

"It's been a thousand years. The person who finally got me out."

The man grabbed Sol's hands tightly, his eyes shining as if overcome with emotion. His eyes twinkled like a mischievous little demon, but his heavily muscled body was that of a grown man, and his face was beautiful enough to perfectly suit his title as a 'fairy.'

Without realizing it, Sol swallowed hard as she took in his appearance. Then, out of nowhere, Jinhwi kissed the back of her hand.

"Nice to meet you, Master. Now that you've awakened me, go ahead and make a wish."

"Make a... what?"

"Didn't you read the manual? Your three sexual fantasies."
